status: draft; not accepted or frozen; no route, engine language, syntax or LQ selected

common.context: KI.3 Context; invocation services use LI.5; continuations keep the admitted command/job and row identity
common.binding: KI.3 Binding on every state-dependent payload; KN0.4 partials and KN0.5 verdicts are never coerced
common.ownership: KI.4 and KI.5 apply to every buffer; payloads immutable, cursors private; explicitly borrowed inputs and newly owning results
common.admission: No runtime commit/app registration. Effective grants and current gates apply; LI.7 distinguishes refused from post-admission failed. Missing production resource descriptors prevent admission under DET.54.
common.outcome: KN5.21 Receipt plus KN7.3 JobResult for jobs. Exact payload and host envelope stay separate under DET.6. LI.28 maps cut-off to cancelled(budget). Live polling is host work; reproducible runtime consumers use captured permitted terminals as declared inputs or their own serial child at a fixed continuation (KI.3).
common.stream: KI.8 semantic schedule; KI.4 Chunk<T>; complete units only. Final summary belongs to the last admitted unit; no completion if its output charge fails.
common.cancellation: KI.9: preserve admitted counters/output, release abandoned job owners; no negative claims or unplayed suffix assertions

kernel.engine_isolate: Typed request/reply inside engine process; checked host-language boundary and immutable owners still required.
kernel.runtime_process: Request pins, scoped IDs and arguments cross runtime/engine; requested result descriptors and immutable buffers return; ownership acknowledgements cross back.
kernel.shell_process: Same payload crosses shell/engine on an off-UI worker; runtime receives no token or session-file access.

local.engine_isolate: No kernel/process transfer; this helper operates on already owned immutable values.
local.runtime_process: No kernel/process transfer; its source values crossed only at their producing operation.

host.engine_isolate: Shell/adapter/engine host path carries this payload independently of the runtime isolate.
host.runtime_process: Shell/adapter/engine host path bypasses the runtime process entirely.
host.shell_process: Privileged shell/adapter/engine path, inaccessible to user runtime even in the same process.

resource.engine_isolate: Local ownership bookkeeping, or typed engine owner request/acknowledgement; no raw pointer exposure.
resource.runtime_process: Local owner needs no transfer; engine owner uses scoped resource ID and retain/release acknowledgement across runtime/engine.
resource.shell_process: Local owner needs no transfer; engine owner uses the same request/acknowledgement across shell/engine.

stream.engine_isolate: Local word streams stay local; kernel streams exchange typed continuation and immutable chunk owners inside the isolate boundary.
stream.runtime_process: Local word streams stay local; kernel stream ID/index and request pins cross out, chunk/summary/status return with ownership acknowledgement.
stream.shell_process: Local word streams stay local; kernel continuations/chunks use shell/engine transfer off the UI thread.

publication.engine_isolate: Typed runtime request enters command service locally; the complete publication and immutable leases cross to the view-model host if separate; no backend handle returns to runtime.
publication.runtime_process: Complete publication, pins and admission envelope cross runtime/command/view-model boundary; Receipt returns; adapter receives host-owned data separately.
publication.shell_process: Command admission is still required; complete content crosses only if command/view-model host is separate; local adapter handoff remains privileged and off the UI path.

requires.why: Resolve KN2.2 snapshot opening through the H-08 services registration; no command or mutation permission.
Register explicit snapshot close/acknowledgement; not a durable workspace or puzzle action.
Name the charged continuation of an already admitted stream, including its final summary; not another lane admission.
Register charged owning aliases for buffers and derived references; no mutation of payload or state.
Register logical drop and remote release acknowledgement for result owners/streams/derived values.
Register the existing command/request outcome lookup; no replay or new invocation.
Register the existing command/job result lookup; retain descriptors even after large payload release.
Name LI.9's direction-specific action-order/target hint as a bounded shell service, without enumerating journal history.
Resolve the delta command in the final H-08 table; bind pose/height/seam fields and aggregation under this one query.
Name RPI.10 publication registration; scheduled publication finalizes its existing view invocation, not a second lane acquisition.

result_fields.meaning: Explicit batch sharing exact replay/seam/height work at each actual prefix

result_fields.name: stream.items
result_fields.meaning: index, exact letter, before/after pose digests, application verdict/certificates, moved set, N before/after/delta, histogram delta, optional delta-u, Phi before/after/delta, maximum piece height, optional immutable prefix_state; JI.10

result_fields.name: stream.items.D
result_fields.meaning: D=cardinality(lowered_high) before application; undefined(retained_letter) or outside_ia_domain as required

result_fields.name: stream.items.F
result_fields.meaning: F=cardinality(foreign_pieces), exact branch/inside predicate before the supplied letter; never a free set

result_fields.name: summary
result_fields.meaning: JI.11 start/end digests, expanded length, examined/applied ranges, first refused prefix, off counts, delta-N/histogram/u, unit size/landings, lifted starting-lattice pieces, other-off landed/unchanged/changed partition, step flag, peak including start, excursion and tameness; unplayed end and whole-word aggregates undefined

operations.snapshot: Base state plus each exact derived prefix; no live recapture, no state adoption and no output for candidate letters not supplied.

buffers.name: base/word pins, working prefix states, observation chunks and derived references
buffers.owner: job until delivery; chunk owns nested prefix references; retain_value creates separate caller owner
buffers.lifetime: scratch/pins through terminal; delivered owner until release; separately retained prefix survives chunk release
buffers.immutable: each completed prefix state, observations and literal letters
buffers.release: release_value on streams/chunks/retained prefix; job termination frees unreturned prefixes

transfer.payload: state, word pins/letters, fields, named objects and bound out; exact chunk/result descriptors and requested immutable data back; no mutable endpoint or token

operations.cancellation: Keep examined/applied coverage separately. After one admitted row of a two-letter word, cancellation has no row 1, no final end digest or whole-word conclusion. A domain refusal is data at that prefix, not a completed application of the suffix.

accounting.steps: kernel open and declared stream_next events; no interpreter loop over stickers
accounting.kernel_cost: replay plus requested seam/height/F/D work once in row tariff/decomposition; no double charge for shared prefix work; adaptive unbounded work needs KI.8 continuations
accounting.memory: base/word owners, current derived state, exact scratch, chunk and any retained prefixes
accounting.output: complete PrefixObservation chunks and admitted WordObservation only; retained partial output remains charged

operations.caller: runtime with view grant or host
operations.lane: view; scheduled publication finalizes existing command/job

inputs.name: content
inputs.type: Owner<{nodes: List<ViewNode>, plans: List<DisplayPlan>, maps: List<SourceMap>}>
inputs.ownership: seal then move/copy to host lease before installation

result_fields.name: receipt
result_fields.meaning: ViewId/installed publication digest, or superseded/replaced/budget cancellation or typed failure; never committed

result_fields.name: content
result_fields.meaning: Identities, dependencies, source links and coverage exact; drawing coordinates at declared precision; no mechanical decision

operations.snapshot: Plans retain actual base/dependencies and derived subject lineage; never attach old output to new session geometry.

buffers.name: sealed nodes, plans, maps and adapter copies
buffers.owner: run before acceptance; host immutable lease after transfer; adapter owns device/staging copies
buffers.lifetime: through replacement and last safe device use, independently of producing run
buffers.immutable: installed content and producing source versions
buffers.release: caller releases remaining aliases; RM.18/RM.19 retire host/device owners safely

transfer.payload: complete bound publication to command/view-model host via placement boundary; Receipt back; adapter receives host data separately, never runtime device handles

operations.cancellation: Install none of an incomplete publication. Supersession fences old generation; release staged owners safely. Completed installation stays completed even if a later frame fails.

accounting.steps: construction and publish_view events
accounting.kernel_cost: declared validation/encoding and source checks once
accounting.memory: new complete publication alongside old owners; bounded host and physical adapter reservations on handoff
accounting.output: whole canonical publication admitted before installation; reserve carries only bounded status
